description: OSTRICH-SWMM links the OSTRICH optimisation toolkit with the Storm Water Management Model. The repository by the OSTRICH-SWMM maintainers acknowledges support from the City of Buffalo and Buffalo Sewer Authority. Documentation and a JSON configuration schema describe parameter injection into SWMM input templates, simulator execution, and extraction of node or link flow statistics. Outputs include event counts, volumes, durations and start or end times for selected events. Catchment coverage, simulation period and reporting resolution follow the supplied SWMM project, not a fixed city dataset. Public source, configuration metadata and examples are free under GPL-2.0. OSTRICH and SWMM are external requirements, and local executable paths must be configured. The short README and older changelog do not establish compatibility with every current version, and no calibration or optimisation run was tested. The tool supports drainage calibration, green-infrastructure planning and combined-sewer-overflow studies using EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm). Its linked papers describe applications, but this resource record represents the reusable coupling tool, not an independently verified Buffalo case outcome.
